\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) =
\begin{cases}
m(x,y) & |I(x,y) - m(x,y)| > T \\
I(x,y) & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases},
\qquad T = 40
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(m(x, y)\): The median of the window around the pixel
- \(T\): The detection threshold

m is the median of the window. A pixel far from the median of its neighbors is taken as an impulse and replaced by that median. Pixels close to it keep their own value. This switching between the median and the input is the idea of Sun and Neuvo (1994).
